title: India Gate
summary: India Gate in New Delhi is a 42 m high arch commemorating Indian soldiers who died in the First World War. The Duke of Connaught laid its foundation stone in 1921 and Viceroy Lord Irwin dedicated it ten years later; Edwin Lutyens designed it.

uncertainty.note: Foundation stone 1921 and dedication ten years later (1931), per the Delhi government page; ThePrint gives 10 February 1921 and February 1931.

as_recorded.value: The foundation stone of India Gate was laid by His Royal Highness, the Duke of Connaught in 1921
The monument was dedicated to the nation 10 years later by the then Viceroy, Lord Irwin
